title: observability: token-level KV cache cost/latency dashboards + alert tuning
author: Aisha Kaur
description:
Add token-level KV cache metrics, cost/latency breakdowns, Grafana dashboards, and alert tuning. Motivation: customers and SRE have asked for better visibility into per-token cost and latency, and the KV cache hit/miss behavior that drives token-level cost. This change provides low-cardinality token-level summaries, per-model/per-route tagging, tracing spans for KV lookups and kernel selection, and tuned alerts to reduce noise while surfacing regression-level changes.

What this PR does:
- Exposes new Prometheus metrics: redwood_tokens_cost_total, redwood_tokens_latency_seconds_bucket (labels: model, route, deployment, quantization_profile), redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_lookup_seconds_bucket, redwood_kv_cache_fill_seconds_sum. Metrics are aggregated at minute resolution and include a synthesized cost tag aggregated from token length and kernel selection.
- Adds tracing spans for: kv.cache_lookup, runtime.kernel_select, runtime.batch_enqueue, runtime.kv_fill. Spans propagate request_id and model_version.
- Adds Grafana dashboards: "Token-level Cost & Latency (Per-model)", "KV Cache Overview", "Token Cost Regression Heatmap". Dashboards include panels for p50/p95/p99 token latency, cost/unit, kv hit ratio, and per-route breakdowns.
- Alert tuning: existing high-frequency alerts on token latency were causing noise. Adjusted thresholds, added adaptive windowing (5m rising -> 30m sustained for page), and introduced a new "token_cost_regression" alert that fires when cost per token increases >15% week-over-week for a model.
- Adds a synthetic probe job that exercises common routes to keep dashboards populated and detect regressions.
- Observability docs updated with dashboard screenshots and guidance for interpreting metrics.

Checklist:
- [x] Metrics instrumented and unit tested (metrics counters/histograms)
- [x] Tracing spans added and integrated with existing tracing pipeline
- [x] Grafana dashboards committed and JSON exports included
- [x] Alerts tuned and runbook updated
- [x] Load test run to verify metrics scale and low-cardinality design

Backward compatibility / notes:
- No breaking API changes. Metrics additions are additive. Cardinality kept low by tagging at model+route+deployment granularity and avoiding prompt-level tags.

Rollout plan:
- Roll out to canary cluster for 48h, monitor dashboards and CI synthetic probes, then roll to prod. Alerts initially set to notify on Slack only for the first 24h.

Related: ENG-4821 (token-cost observability epic), SUP-1298 (customer request for KV cache visibility).
